newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Burundi-based Air Tanganyika appoints Dutch GSA.
newsitem.headline: Burundi-based Air Tanganyika appoints Dutch GSA.

text.p: Air Tanganyika has appointed Kales Airline Service BV as its Dutch and Scandinavian general sales agent for both cargo and passenger services, the GSA's director, Peter Kales told Reuters.
The newly-established Bujumbura-based airline operates a weekly Boeing 707 freighter flight on Friday from Ostend to the Burundi capital.
This is also the first time the carrier will have flown into Europe as Air Tanganyika has taken over the traffic rights of Air Burundi into Europe, said Kales.
Medicines, relief cargo, machinery and spare parts are likely to be the main cargo from Ostend and tea and coffee will be flown into Belgium.
However, if this cargo is not available, the airline will fly via Kenya and pick-up flowers or via Egypt, where it will pick-up beans, added Kales.

Under European Union regulations, noisier aircraft face a ban at Ostend airport from the start of 1998 and unless they have a special exemption, Boeing 707s and Douglas DC-8s will have to leave the airport.
Kales said that Air Tanganyika will then look for another aircraft to continue operations, probably a Mcdonnell Douglas DC-10 or Airbus freighter, he added.
The airline's main European general sales agent is the Belgian concern, New ITS, based in Charleroi.

Kales also handles the passenger flights which operate from Charleroi to Bujumbura. These began operations on Thursday July 31 with a Boeing 707 but in October this is likely to be replaced with an Airbus 300 or Airbus 310 in October, added Kales.

Trucking from Schiphol Airport to Ostend will be carried out by Jan de Rijk or Rutges BV and the airline will be handled by Airport Cargo at Schiphol. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
